System Context & Goal:
Act as an expert React/TypeScript app developer, database architect, and UI/UX designer. Build an advanced, automated, role-based mobile web app for a jewelry business powered by a connected Google Sheet SDK. This must function as a comprehensive CRM, Order Tracker, and Invoicing system. The final product must be easy to use, visually clean, and precise, minimizing cognitive load for the staff while ensuring strict adherence to typography and branding guidelines.
CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Upon generation, verify the app works by testing the switching between all 4 tabs, expanding client cards, inline editing details, and changing statuses without errors.

1. Core Architecture & UI/UX Principles

Mobile-First & Clean UI: Optimize heavily for mobile devices. Use whitespace effectively and intuitive navigation.

Role-Based Security: Secure login with strict permissions across 4 tabs: Admin Pipeline, Dispatch Board, Accounts Tracking, and Bossing Dashboard.

Global Action Button: Implement an omnipresent "Upload Masterlist" action button linking to the "Uploads" table.

Branding & Typography: * Use Cinzel Bold strictly for all headers, invoice titles, and highlighted metric text.

Use Lato for all body text, list items, data inputs, and general data.

Apply primary brand colors to buttons and active states.

Currency Conversion Automation (CRITICAL): AED is the default currency. The system MUST automatically convert foreign currencies to AED for all background calculations (profit, Remaining Balance, Executive Dashboards) using virtual fields. (e.g., If USD, multiply by 3.67. If PHP, divide by 15.5). Display original currency to the client, but use AED for company math. Ensure the Currency column is mapped.

2. Global Data Rules, CRM Logic & Validation

CRM Smart Client Bundling (CRITICAL): Visually merge flat rows with the same Miner Name into a single "Client Profile" (Parent Record) in all list views.

Precise Date Formatting: Format all dates strictly as short dates (e.g., "MMM DD, YYYY"). Strip out any raw ISO timestamp strings.

Automated Due Date: Create a virtual calculated field where Due Date = Date of Live + 3 Days.

SDK Type Casting: Ensure mc (Making Charge) and supplier rate are parsed to floats for math. downpayment is parsed as a number.

Smart Financial Calculation:

Item Price: If Grams contains text (like "PC"), Item Price = client rate. If Grams is a number, Item Price = (Grams * client rate).

Item Cost: If Grams contains text (like "PC") OR Category is "Silver", Item Cost = supplier rate + MC (Making Charge). If Gold by weight, Item Cost = (Gold rate * Grams) + MC.

Profit: profit = Item Price - Item Cost.

3. Role: Admin Pipeline (Frontline Processing & CRM Entry)

Filter Rule: Show only records where status is "Pending" or "Waiting for Details".

Grouping: Group lists by Miner Name (Client Profile view).

Visible Fields: Miner Name, Item Description, Category, Grams, Currency, status, mode of payment, Regions, Location of Miner, FB Profile Name.

Actions/Buttons (Speed Optimized):

NO separate Edit details tab/modal. Build inline editing directly on the client card/list view for mode of payment, Regions, and Liver/Admin Remarks so the admin can update instantly.

Conditional Validation Gate: Do not allow status to change to "For Pullout" UNLESS mode of payment is filled. AND, if Location of Miner strictly equals "Local", the Regions field MUST also be filled. (Ignore the region requirement for International or Pinas miners).

MOP Dropdown: Tabby, Tamara, COD, Bank Transfer, Credit Card, Meet Up, Pick Up Shop, Layaway.

Promo Toggle: Quick toggle for "FREE SF". Map this to the Free SF sheet column.

Quick Status Dropdown: "For Pullout" or "Cancelled".

4. Role: Dispatch Board (Logistics & Fulfillment)

Filter Rule: Show only records where status is "For Pullout" or "Dispatched".

Grouping (CRITICAL - SEPARATE LOCATIONS): Primary Group by Location of Miner (Local, Pinas, International) to separate shipping schedules. Secondary Group by Source (facility). Tertiary Group by Miner Name (bundled).

Automated Shipping Logic: Calculate virtual Shipping Fee based on this strict hierarchy:

If Free SF is checked/true -> Shipping Fee = 0.

If mode of payment = "Pick Up Shop" -> Shipping Fee = 0.

If mode of payment = "Meet Up" -> Shipping Fee = 10.

If Location of Miner = "Local" AND none of the above apply -> Dubai = 25; Western Region = 45; Abu Dhabi/Sharjah/Ajman/UAQ/RAK/Fujairah = 30.

Actions/Buttons:

Quick Status Change: "Dispatched", "Delivered", OR "Cancelled".

Generate Pullout Report (INTERNAL USE ONLY): Export a consolidated printable internal list. FILTER: ONLY include items where status is "For Pullout" (Do NOT include "Dispatched"). Group by Source. Include Date of Live, Gold rate, and profit. Do NOT format this as an invoice.

5. Role: Accounts Tracking (Financials & Layaway CRM)

Primary View Filter: Show records where (status is "Delivered" OR mode of payment is "Layaway") AND (Remittance Status is empty, "Pending Payment", OR Remaining Balance > 0).

Secondary View (Cleared Accounts): Separate sub-tab for records where Remittance Status is Secured/Received.

Surcharge & Extra Fees Logic: * CC Fee: If mode of payment = "Credit Card", CC Fee = 5. Otherwise, 0.

Calculated Fields:

Total Paid: downpayment + la 1 month payment + la 2 month payment + la 3 month payment + la 4 month payment + Amount Received.

Remaining Balance: (Item Price + Shipping Fee + CC Fee + Additional Charges) - Total Paid.

Actions/Buttons (Edit Financials Form):

Inputs: Gold rate/supplier rate, MC (Making Charge).

Manual Extra Entries: Map the "Additional Charges" input to the Additional Charges sheet column, and the "Amount Received" input to the Amount Received sheet column.

Layaway Conditional Logic: Disable/Lock the inputs for la 1 month payment through la 4 month payment UNLESS the mode of payment is exactly "Layaway".

Remittance Dropdown: Pending Payment, Secured via Courier, Secured via Bank Transfer, Secured via Cash.

6. Bossing Dashboard (Executive View)

Filter Rule: Show ALL records where status is NOT "Cancelled".

Date Range Control: Global Date Filter toggle (defaulting to "All Time").

Permissions: Strictly Read-Only. No charts/graphs, just clean data.

Top Metrics (KPIs in AED):

Total Expected Profit (Sum of all calculated profit for active/sold items, converted to AED).

Total Items Sold.

Outstanding Receivables (Sum of all Remaining Balances in AED).

7. Document Generation (Client Invoice)

Generate Invoice Button (CRITICAL): This must be entirely separate from the Dispatch Pullout report. Format as a professional receipt to send to the customer.

Header: Date of Live, Miner Name, Regions, mode of payment, Due Date.

Line Items: Loop bundled items. Show Item Description, Category, Grams, and client rate.

Totals Section: Subtotal + Shipping Fee + Additional Charges + (If Credit Card, +5 Surcharge). Display Grand Total.

input.content:
# Jewelry CRM — Role-Based Mobile Web App

## Scope Summary
A comprehensive mobile-first CRM, Order Tracker, and Invoicing system for a jewelry business, powered by the connected Google Sheet. The app has four role-gated tabs (Admin Pipeline, Dispatch Board, Accounts Tracking, Bossing Dashboard), all virtual financial calculations done on the frontend, and a client invoice generator. Google login handles authentication; roles are assigned by email address configured in code.

---

## ⚠️ Key Constraints & Decisions

### Role-Based Access
The user requested Google login + a separate Roles sheet, **but Google Sheets structure cannot be modified via the SDK.** Resolution:
- Google login (via `loginWithRedirect`) for authentication
- Roles are assigned by **email address**, configured as a hardcoded map in a shared config file (e.g., `adminEmails: [...]`, `dispatchEmails: [...]`, etc.)
- Users not in any role list see an "Access Denied" screen
- This is easy to update — just edit the config and redeploy

### PC (Piece-Based) Items
The user confirmed a "separate column/field" indicates PC items, **but no such column exists in the current SDK.** Resolution:
- If `grams` is `0`, `null`, or `undefined` → treat as **PC item** (flat rate pricing)
- If `grams` is a positive number → treat as **weight-based** item
- ⚠️ **User should verify this assumption matches how their sheet works**

### Profit Column
- App will **recalculate profit on the fly** and ignore the sheet's `profit` column
- Calculated profit will **not** be written back to the sheet

---

## Data Source: `Database` Sheet

All main operations read from and write to the `Database` sheet.

**Fields used per tab:**

| Field (SDK name) | Used In |
|---|---|
| `id`, `orderId`, `dateOfLive` | All tabs |
| `minerName`, `locationOfMiner`, `regions` | All tabs |
| `fbProfileName`, `liverName`, `page` | Admin Pipeline |
| `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams` | All tabs |
| `source`, `status`, `modeOfPayment` | All tabs |
| `currency`, `clientRate`, `goldRate` | Calculations |
| `supplierRate`, `mc` | Calculations (parsed to float) |
| `freeSf`, `liverAdminRemarks` | Admin Pipeline, Dispatch |
| `dispatchDate`, `deliveredDate` | Dispatch Board |
| `downpayment`, `la1MonthPayment`–`la4MonthPayment` | Accounts |
| `additionalCharges`, `amountReceived` | Accounts |
| `remittanceStatus` | Accounts |

**`Uploads` sheet** — used by the global "Upload Masterlist" button (create new upload records).

---

## Virtual / Calculated Fields (Frontend Only)

All calculations happen on the frontend. Nothing is written back to the sheet except explicit user edits.

- **Due Date** = `dateOfLive` + 3 days (formatted as "MMM DD, YYYY")
- **Item Price** = if PC item → `clientRate`; else → `grams * clientRate`
- **Item Cost** = if PC item OR category = "Silver" → `parseFloat(supplierRate) + parseFloat(mc)`; else → `(goldRate * grams) + parseFloat(mc)`
- **Profit (AED)** = `itemPriceAED - itemCostAED` (after currency conversion)
- **AED Conversion** = if `currency = "USD"` → value × 3.67; if `currency = "PHP"` → value ÷ 15.5; if `currency = "AED"` → no change; other currencies → show raw value with a warning flag
- **Shipping Fee** = hierarchy: Free SF → 0; MOP = "Pick Up Shop" → 0; MOP = "Meet Up" → 10 AED; Local + region lookup (Dubai=25, Western Region=45, others=30)
- **CC Fee** = if `modeOfPayment = "Credit Card"` → 5; else → 0
- **Total Paid** = `downpayment + la1–la4 payments + amountReceived` (all parsed as floats)
- **Remaining Balance** = `(itemPrice + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges) - totalPaid`

---

## Backend Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|
| `getRecords` | Fetch all `Database` rows (no server-side filter; filtering happens on frontend) |
| `updateRecord` | Update a row in `Database` by `rowId` |
| `getUploads` | Fetch all `Uploads` rows |
| `createUpload` | Create a new row in `Uploads` |

---

## Frontend Structure

**Single-page app** with bottom tab navigation (mobile-optimized):

1. **Admin Pipeline** — Filtered: status = "Pending" or "Waiting for Details". Grouped by `minerName`. Inline editing for `modeOfPayment`, `regions`, `liverAdminRemarks`. Validation gate before "For Pullout". Promo toggle for `freeSf`. Quick status dropdown.

2. **Dispatch Board** — Filtered: status = "For Pullout" or "Dispatched". Triple-grouped: `locationOfMiner` → `source` → `minerName`. Calculated shipping fee shown. Quick status change. "Generate Pullout Report" (printable, internal-use, "For Pullout" only).

3. **Accounts Tracking** — Two sub-tabs: Active (delivered/layaway with balance) and Cleared. Edit Financials form per record. Layaway inputs locked unless MOP = "Layaway". Remittance dropdown.

4. **Bossing Dashboard** — All non-cancelled records. Date range filter. Read-only KPI cards: Total Expected Profit (AED), Total Items Sold, Outstanding Receivables (AED).

**Global elements:**
- "Upload Masterlist" floating action button (visible on all tabs)
- Client Invoice generator (modal/sheet): professional receipt per bundled client, with line items, totals, surcharges

**Typography:**
- `Cinzel Bold` (Google Font) for all headers, invoice titles, KPI metric values
- `Lato` (Google Font) for all body text, inputs, data

---

## Assumptions

1. **PC item detection**: `grams` being `0`/`null`/`undefined` = PC item. ⚠️ User should confirm this.
2. **Currency conversion rates**: USD × 3.67, PHP ÷ 15.5. These will be constants in a config file.
3. **Shipping regions for Local**: "Dubai" = 25 AED, "Western Region" = 45 AED, all other UAE regions (Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, UAQ, RAK, Fujairah) = 30 AED.
4. **Status values**: Pending, Waiting for Details, For Pullout, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled.
5. **`freeSf` values in sheet**: Treated as truthy if the string is "TRUE", "true", "1", "Yes", or "yes".
6. **Role config**: Stored as a hardcoded email list in `src/config/roles.ts` — easy to update.
7. All financial inputs (`mc`, `supplierRate`, `downpayment`, layaway payments, `additionalCharges`, `amountReceived`) are parsed as `parseFloat` before calculations.

---

## Out of Scope
- Adding a new "Roles" sheet to Google Sheets (SDK limitation)
- Charts or graphs in the Bossing Dashboard (explicitly excluded per requirements)
- Writing calculated profit back to the sheet

Mobile-First & Clean UI: Optimize heavily for mobile devices. Use whitespace effectively. The interface must feature a global search and role-based filtering.

Role-Based Security: Secure login with strict permissions across 4 main tabs: Admin Pipeline, Dispatch Board, Accounts Tracking, and Bossing Dashboard.

Client 360 Main Record: When a user clicks into a "Client Profile", expand to show Client Name, Date of Live, Due Date, and all bundled Item Descriptions/Orders.

Global Action Button: Implement an omnipresent "Upload Masterlist" action button linking to the "Uploads" table to add new Excel files.

Branding & Typography: Use Cinzel Bold strictly for all headers, invoice titles, and highlighted metric text. Use Lato for all body text, list items, data inputs, and general data. Apply primary brand colors to buttons and active states.

Currency Conversion Automation (CRITICAL): AED is the default currency globally. The system MUST automatically convert foreign currencies to AED for all background calculations (profit, Remaining Balance, Executive Dashboards) using virtual fields (e.g., if USD multiply by 3.67, if PHP divide by 15.5). Display original currency to the client, but use AED for company math. Ensure the "Currency" column is mapped.

Global Data Rules, CRM Logic & Validation

CRM Smart Client Bundling (CRITICAL): Visually merge flat rows with the same "Miner Name" into a single Client Profile (Parent Record) in all list views.

Precise Date Formatting: Format all dates strictly as short dates (e.g., MMM DD, YYYY). Strip out any raw ISO timestamp strings (like T00:00:00.000Z).

Automated Due Date: Create a virtual calculated field where Due Date = Date of Live + 3 Days (matching the 3-day hold policy).

SDK Type Casting (CRITICAL): Based on the latest Google Sheet SDK, "mc" (Making Charge) and "supplier rate" are received as strings and must be parsed to floats for math. "downpayment" is received as a number.

Smart Financial Calculation:

Item Price: If "Grams" contains text (like "PC"), Item Price = client rate. If "Grams" is a number, Item Price = (Grams * client rate).

Item Cost: If "Grams" contains text (like "PC") OR "Category" is "Silver", Item Cost = parsed supplier rate + parsed MC. If Gold by weight, Item Cost = (Gold rate * Grams) + parsed MC.

Profit: profit = Item Price - Item Cost.

Role: Admin Pipeline (Frontline Processing & CRM Entry)

Filter Rule: Show only records where status is "Pending" or "Waiting for Details".

Grouping: Group lists by Miner Name.

Visible Fields: Miner Name, Item Description, Category, Grams, Currency, status, mode of payment, Regions, Location of Miner, FB Profile Name.

Actions/Buttons (Speed Optimized):

NO separate Edit details tab/modal. Build inline editing directly on the client card/list view for mode of payment, Regions, and Liver/Admin Remarks to maximize speed.

Conditional Validation Gate: Do not allow status to change to "For Pullout" UNLESS mode of payment is filled. AND, if Location of Miner strictly equals "Local", the Regions field MUST also be filled. (Ignore the region requirement for International or Pinas miners).

MOP Dropdown: Tabby, Tamara, COD, Bank Transfer, Credit Card, Meet Up, Pick Up Shop, Layaway.

Promo Toggle: Quick toggle/checkbox for "FREE SF". Map this to the Free SF sheet column.

Quick Status Dropdown: "For Pullout" or "Cancelled".

Strict 24-Hour SLA Alert (CRITICAL): The system must compare the current time against the Date of Live. IF Current Time is >24 hours past the Date of Live AND status is still "Pending", trigger a highly visible OVERDUE state (e.g., bold red badge, highlighted row).

Role: Dispatch Board (Logistics & Fulfillment)

Filter Rule: Show only records where status is "For Pullout" or "Dispatched".

Grouping (CRITICAL SEPARATION): Primary Group by Location of Miner (Local, Pinas, International) to separate shipping schedules. Secondary Group by Source (facility). Tertiary Group by Miner Name (bundled).

Automated Shipping Logic: Calculate virtual Shipping Fee based on this strict hierarchy:

If Free SF toggle is true -> Shipping Fee = 0.

If mode of payment = "Pick Up Shop" -> Shipping Fee = 0.

If mode of payment = "Meet Up" -> Shipping Fee = 10.

If Location of Miner = "Local" AND none of the above apply -> Dubai = 25; Western Region = 45; Abu Dhabi/Sharjah/Ajman/UAQ/RAK/Fujairah = 30.

Actions/Buttons:

Quick Status Change: "Dispatched", "Delivered", OR "Cancelled".

Automated Dates: When status -> "Dispatched", auto-capture current date/time to Dispatch Date. When status -> "Delivered", auto-capture current date/time to Delivered Date.

Generate Pullout Report Component (INTERNAL USE ONLY): Export a consolidated printable internal list. FILTER: ONLY include items where status is "For Pullout" (Do NOT include "Dispatched"). Group by Source. Include Miner Name, Item Description, Category, Grams, Date of Live, Gold Rate, and profit. Show totals per Source group. Do NOT format this as an invoice.

Role: Accounts Tracking (Financials & Layaway CRM)

Primary View Filter: Show records where (status is "Delivered" OR mode of payment is "Layaway") AND (Remittance Status is empty, "Pending Payment", OR Remaining Balance > 0).

Secondary View (Cleared Accounts): Separate saved view/sub-tab for records where Remittance Status is Secured/Received.

Surcharge & Extra Fees Logic: If mode of payment = "Credit Card", CC Fee = 5. Otherwise, 0.

Total Paid: downpayment + la 1 month payment + la 2 month payment + la 3 month payment + la 4 month payment + Amount Received.

Remaining Balance: (Item Price + Shipping Fee + CC Fee + Additional Charges) - Total Paid.

Actions/Buttons (Edit Financials Form):

Bossing Dashboard (Executive View)

Filter Rule: Show ALL records where status is NOT "Cancelled".

Saved Views & Filters: Global Date Filter toggle (defaulting to "All Time") to show historical data.

Permissions: Strictly Read-Only. Clean interface, no charts/graphs needed.

Total Items Sold.

Outstanding Receivables (Sum of all Remaining Balances in AED).

# Jewelry CRM — Role-Based Mobile Web App

## Scope Summary

A comprehensive mobile-first CRM, Order Tracker, and Invoicing system for a jewelry business, powered by the connected Google Sheet. The app has four role-gated tabs (Admin Pipeline, Dispatch Board, Accounts Tracking, Bossing Dashboard), all virtual financial calculations done on the frontend, and a client invoice generator. Google login handles authentication; roles are assigned by email address configured in code.

---

## ⚠️ Key Constraints & Decisions

### Role-Based Access

The user requested Google login + a separate Roles sheet, **but Google Sheets structure cannot be modified via the SDK.** Resolution:

- Google login (via `loginWithRedirect`) for authentication
- Roles are assigned by **email address**, configured as a hardcoded map in a shared config file (e.g., `adminEmails: [...]`, `dispatchEmails: [...]`, etc.)
- Users not in any role list see an "Access Denied" screen
- This is easy to update — just edit the config and redeploy

### PC (Piece-Based) Items

The user confirmed a "separate column/field" indicates PC items, **but no such column exists in the current SDK.** Resolution:

- If `grams` is `0`, `null`, or `undefined` → treat as **PC item** (flat rate pricing)
- If `grams` is a positive number → treat as **weight-based** item
- ⚠️ **User should verify this assumption matches how their sheet works**

### Profit Column

- App will **recalculate profit on the fly** and ignore the sheet's `profit` column
- Calculated profit will **not** be written back to the sheet

---

## Data Source: `Database` Sheet

All main operations read from and write to the `Database` sheet.

**Fields used per tab:**

`**Uploads` sheet** — used by the global "Upload Masterlist" button (create new upload records).

---

## Virtual / Calculated Fields (Frontend Only)

All calculations happen on the frontend. Nothing is written back to the sheet except explicit user edits.

- **Due Date** = `dateOfLive` + 3 days (formatted as "MMM DD, YYYY")
- **Item Price** = if PC item → `clientRate`; else → `grams * clientRate`
- **Item Cost** = if PC item OR category = "Silver" → `parseFloat(supplierRate) + parseFloat(mc)`; else → `(goldRate * grams) + parseFloat(mc)`
- **Profit (AED)** = `itemPriceAED - itemCostAED` (after currency conversion)
- **AED Conversion** = if `currency = "USD"` → value × 3.67; if `currency = "PHP"` → value ÷ 15.5; if `currency = "AED"` → no change; other currencies → show raw value with a warning flag
- **Shipping Fee** = hierarchy: Free SF → 0; MOP = "Pick Up Shop" → 0; MOP = "Meet Up" → 10 AED; Local + region lookup (Dubai=25, Western Region=45, others=30)
- **CC Fee** = if `modeOfPayment = "Credit Card"` → 5; else → 0
- **Total Paid** = `downpayment + la1–la4 payments + amountReceived` (all parsed as floats)
- **Remaining Balance** = `(itemPrice + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges) - totalPaid`

---

## Backend Endpoints

---

## Frontend Structure

**Single-page app** with bottom tab navigation (mobile-optimized):

1. **Admin Pipeline** — Filtered: status = "Pending" or "Waiting for Details". Grouped by `minerName`. Inline editing for `modeOfPayment`, `regions`, `liverAdminRemarks`. Validation gate before "For Pullout". Promo toggle for `freeSf`. Quick status dropdown.
2. **Dispatch Board** — Filtered: status = "For Pullout" or "Dispatched". Triple-grouped: `locationOfMiner` → `source` → `minerName`. Calculated shipping fee shown. Quick status change. "Generate Pullout Report" (printable, internal-use, "For Pullout" only).
3. **Accounts Tracking** — Two sub-tabs: Active (delivered/layaway with balance) and Cleared. Edit Financials form per record. Layaway inputs locked unless MOP = "Layaway". Remittance dropdown.
4. **Bossing Dashboard** — All non-cancelled records. Date range filter. Read-only KPI cards: Total Expected Profit (AED), Total Items Sold, Outstanding Receivables (AED).

**Global elements:**

- "Upload Masterlist" floating action button (visible on all tabs)
- Client Invoice generator (modal/sheet): professional receipt per bundled client, with line items, totals, surcharges

**Typography:**

- `Cinzel Bold` (Google Font) for all headers, invoice titles, KPI metric values
- `Lato` (Google Font) for all body text, inputs, data

---

## Assumptions

1. **PC item detection**: `grams` being `0`/`null`/`undefined` = PC item. ⚠️ User should confirm this.
2. **Currency conversion rates**: USD × 3.67, PHP ÷ 15.5. These will be constants in a config file.
3. **Shipping regions for Local**: "Dubai" = 25 AED, "Western Region" = 45 AED, all other UAE regions (Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, UAQ, RAK, Fujairah) = 30 AED.
4. **Status values**: Pending, Waiting for Details, For Pullout, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled.
5. `**freeSf` values in sheet**: Treated as truthy if the string is "TRUE", "true", "1", "Yes", or "yes".
6. **Role config**: Stored as a hardcoded email list in `src/config/roles.ts` — easy to update.
7. All financial inputs (`mc`, `supplierRate`, `downpayment`, layaway payments, `additionalCharges`, `amountReceived`) are parsed as `parseFloat` before calculations.

---

## Out of Scope

- Adding a new "Roles" sheet to Google Sheets (SDK limitation)
- Charts or graphs in the Bossing Dashboard (explicitly excluded per requirements)
- Writing calculated profit back to the sheet

input.content:
# Jewelry CRM — Role-Based Mobile Web App

## Scope Summary

A comprehensive mobile-first CRM, Order Tracker, and Invoicing system for a jewelry business, powered by the connected Google Sheet. Four strictly role-gated tabs (each user sees exactly one tab), global search, all virtual financial calculations on the frontend, a client invoice generator, and an internal pullout report. Google login handles authentication; roles are assigned by email address in a config file.

---

## Resolved Decisions

### PC Item Detection (CONFIRMED)
The `grams` column in the sheet contains text like "PER PC" or "3 PC" for flat-rate items. Because the SDK casts `grams` as a number, those text values arrive as `null`, `NaN`, or `0`. **Final rule:**
- If `grams` is `null`, `NaN`, or `0` → PC/flat-rate item
- If `category` strictly equals `"Silver"` → also PC/flat-rate item
- Otherwise → weight-based item

### Role Permissions (CONFIRMED)
Strict **1 role = 1 tab**. Each user sees only their assigned tab:
- `adminEmails` → Admin Pipeline only
- `dispatchEmails` → Dispatch Board only
- `accountsEmails` → Accounts Tracking only
- `bossingEmails` → Bossing Dashboard only
- Unrecognized emails → "Access Denied" screen

### Brand Colors (CONFIRMED)
Black + gold, high-end minimal theme:
- Background: near-black (`hsl(0, 0%, 6%)`)
- Card surface: dark gray (`hsl(0, 0%, 10%)`)
- Primary / gold accent: `hsl(43, 96%, 50%)`
- Foreground: off-white (`hsl(0, 0%, 95%)`)
- Muted text: `hsl(0, 0%, 55%)`)
- Border: `hsl(0, 0%, 18%)`
- Destructive: `hsl(0, 72%, 51%)`
- Cinzel Bold + Lato loaded via Google Fonts

### `freeSf` Field (CONFIRMED)
Currently empty/unused in the sheet. The app will be the **first to write** to this column. Values written: `"TRUE"` (toggled on) or `""` (empty, toggled off). Read as truthy if value is `"TRUE"` or `"true"`.

### Regions Dropdown (CONFIRMED)
Fixed UAE-only dropdown for the `regions` inline edit field:
`Dubai`, `Abu Dhabi`, `Sharjah`, `Ajman`, `Western Region`, `UAQ`, `RAK`, `Fujairah`

---

## Data Source

### `Database` Sheet

All main operations read from and write to this sheet. SDK field names:

| SDK Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | number | Row ID for updates |
| `orderId` | string | Display reference |
| `dateOfLive` | string | ISO string — format as "MMM DD, YYYY" |
| `minerName` | string | Grouping key (Client Profile) |
| `locationOfMiner` | string | "Local", "Pinas", or "International" |
| `regions` | string | UAE region; required for Local + "For Pullout" |
| `fbProfileName` | string | Shown in Admin Pipeline |
| `liverName` | string | Liver/source info |
| `page` | string | Source page |
| `itemDescription` | string | Line item |
| `category` | string | "Gold", "Silver", etc. |
| `grams` | number | null/NaN/0 = PC item |
| `source` | string | Facility — used for Dispatch grouping |
| `currency` | string | "AED", "USD", "PHP", possibly others |
| `clientRate` | number | Client-facing price per gram or flat |
| `goldRate` | number | Gold spot rate |
| `supplierRate` | string | **Parse as float** |
| `mc` | string | Making Charge — **parse as float** |
| `status` | string | Pending, Waiting for Details, For Pullout, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled |
| `modeOfPayment` | string | Tabby, Tamara, COD, Bank Transfer, Credit Card, Meet Up, Pick Up Shop, Layaway |
| `modeOfSale` | string | In SDK but NOT used in requirements — ignore |
| `freeSf` | string | App writes "TRUE" or ""; reads truthy if "TRUE"/"true" |
| `downpayment` | string | **Parse as float** (SDK types as string) |
| `la1MonthPayment`–`la4MonthPayment` | string | **Parse as float**; locked unless MOP = "Layaway" |
| `additionalCharges` | string | **Parse as float** |
| `amountReceived` | string | **Parse as float** |
| `remittanceStatus` | string | Pending Payment, Secured via Courier/Bank Transfer/Cash |
| `dispatchDate` | string | Written by app on status → "Dispatched" |
| `deliveredDate` | string | Written by app on status → "Delivered" |
| `liverAdminRemarks` | string | Inline-editable in Admin Pipeline |
| `profit` | string | **Ignored** — recalculated on the fly |

### `Uploads` Sheet

Used by the global "Upload Masterlist" button. Fields: `uploadId`, `masterlistFile`, `status`.

---

## Virtual / Calculated Fields (Frontend Only)

| Field | Formula |
|---|---|
| Due Date | `dateOfLive` + 3 days |
| Item Price | PC item → `clientRate`; weight-based → `grams * clientRate` |
| Item Cost | PC/Silver → `parseFloat(supplierRate) + parseFloat(mc)`; Gold weight → `(goldRate * grams) + parseFloat(mc)` |
| Profit | Item Price − Item Cost |
| AED Conversion | USD × 3.67; PHP ÷ 15.5; AED = no change |
| Shipping Fee | freeSf="TRUE" → 0; MOP="Pick Up Shop" → 0; MOP="Meet Up" → 10; Local: Dubai=25, Western Region=45, others=30 |
| CC Fee | MOP="Credit Card" → 5; else → 0 |
| Total Paid | `downpayment + la1–la4 + amountReceived` |
| Remaining Balance | `(itemPrice + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges) − totalPaid` |
| 24-Hour SLA Flag | currentTime > `dateOfLive` + 24h AND status = "Pending" |

---

## Backend Endpoints

| Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `getRecords` | Yes | Fetch all `Database` rows (no server-side filter) |
| `updateRecord` | Yes | Update a single `Database` row by `rowId` (partial fields) |
| `getUploads` | Yes | Fetch all `Uploads` rows |
| `createUpload` | Yes | Create a new row in `Uploads` |

---

## Frontend Structure

### Global Shell
- Google login gate — unauthenticated users redirected to login
- Role check after login — unrecognized emails → "Access Denied"
- Bottom tab navigation (user sees only their 1 assigned tab)
- Global search bar — filters by `minerName`, `itemDescription`, `orderId`
- Floating "Upload Masterlist" button — opens sheet/modal to create an `Uploads` record
- Cinzel Bold / Lato fonts via Google Fonts import in `index.css`

### Tab 1: Admin Pipeline
- Filter: `status` = "Pending" or "Waiting for Details"
- Grouped by `minerName` (Client Profile cards)
- Client Profile card expands to show: Client Name, Date of Live, Due Date, all bundled items
- Inline editing (no modal): `modeOfPayment`, `regions`, `liverAdminRemarks`
- `freeSf` toggle (writes "TRUE" or "" to sheet)
- Quick status dropdown: "For Pullout" or "Cancelled"
- Validation gate: "For Pullout" blocked unless MOP filled; if `locationOfMiner` = "Local", `regions` must also be filled
- 24-Hour SLA Alert: bold red OVERDUE badge if status = "Pending" and >24h past `dateOfLive`
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card

### Tab 2: Dispatch Board
- Filter: `status` = "For Pullout" or "Dispatched"
- Grouped: `locationOfMiner` → `source` → `minerName`
- Calculated shipping fee shown per record
- Quick status: "Dispatched", "Delivered", "Cancelled"
- Auto date capture: status → "Dispatched" writes current date to `dispatchDate`; status → "Delivered" writes to `deliveredDate`
- Pullout Report button: printable internal list, `status` = "For Pullout" only, grouped by `source`, includes `minerName`, `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams`, `dateOfLive`, `goldRate`, calculated profit, totals per group

### Tab 3: Accounts Tracking
- Primary sub-tab: (`status` = "Delivered" OR `modeOfPayment` = "Layaway") AND (`remittanceStatus` empty OR "Pending Payment" OR Remaining Balance > 0)
- Cleared sub-tab: `remittanceStatus` contains "Secured" or "Received"
- Edit Financials form: `goldRate`, `supplierRate`, `mc`, `additionalCharges`, `amountReceived`
- Layaway inputs (`la1`–`la4`) locked unless `modeOfPayment` = "Layaway"
- Remittance dropdown: Pending Payment, Secured via Courier, Secured via Bank Transfer, Secured via Cash
- Displayed: Item Price, Item Cost, CC Fee, Shipping Fee, Total Paid, Remaining Balance (AED)

### Tab 4: Bossing Dashboard
- Filter: `status` ≠ "Cancelled"
- Date range filter (default: All Time)
- Read-only KPI cards (AED): Total Expected Profit, Total Items Sold, Outstanding Receivables

### Client Invoice Generator
- Triggered from Client Profile card in Admin Pipeline
- Printable HTML view (`window.print()`) — browser saves as PDF
- Header: `dateOfLive`, `minerName`, `regions`, `modeOfPayment`, Due Date
- Line items: `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams`, `clientRate`, Item Price in AED
- Totals: Subtotal + Shipping Fee + Additional Charges + CC Surcharge + Grand Total in AED

---

## Out of Scope
- Adding a "Roles" sheet to Google Sheets (SDK limitation — use email config instead)
- Charts or graphs anywhere in the app
- Writing calculated profit back to the sheet
- True PDF file generation (printable HTML via `window.print()` is used instead)
- Region options for Pinas or International miners (free-text or not required per requirements)

input.content:
# Jewelry CRM — Role-Based Mobile Web App

## Scope Summary

A comprehensive mobile-first CRM, Order Tracker, and Invoicing system for a jewelry business, powered by the connected Google Sheet. Four strictly role-gated tabs (each user sees exactly one tab), global search, all virtual financial calculations on the frontend, a client invoice generator (accessible on 3 tabs), and an internal pullout report. Google login handles authentication; roles are assigned by email address in a config file.

---

## Resolved Decisions (All Confirmed)

| Decision | Answer |
|---|---|
| PC item detection | `grams` null/NaN/0 OR `category = "Silver"` → flat-rate pricing |
| Role permissions | Strict 1-role = 1-tab; unrecognized emails → Access Denied |
| Brand colors | Black + gold; near-black bg, gold (`hsl(43, 96%, 50%)`) as primary |
| `freeSf` field | App writes first; writes `"TRUE"` on, `""` off |
| Regions dropdown | Fixed UAE list: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Western Region, UAQ, RAK, Fujairah |
| Upload Masterlist | File picker → upload to cloud storage → save URL to `masterlistFile` field in `Uploads` sheet |
| "Waiting for Details" status | Set externally in the sheet only; Admin Pipeline displays it but cannot set it. Quick status dropdown shows "For Pullout" and "Cancelled" only |
| Accounts editing (goldRate, supplierRate, mc) | Saved permanently back to the Google Sheet |
| Bossing Dashboard date ranges | This Week, This Month, Last 3 Months, Custom Date Range, All Time |
| Generate Invoice button | Available on Admin Pipeline, Dispatch Board, AND Accounts Tracking tabs |

---

## Data Source

### `Database` Sheet

| SDK Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | number | Row ID for updates |
| `orderId` | string | Display reference |
| `dateOfLive` | string | ISO string — format as "MMM DD, YYYY" |
| `minerName` | string | Grouping key (Client Profile) |
| `locationOfMiner` | string | "Local", "Pinas", or "International" |
| `regions` | string | UAE region; required for Local + "For Pullout" |
| `fbProfileName` | string | Shown in Admin Pipeline |
| `liverName` | string | Liver/source info |
| `page` | string | Source page |
| `itemDescription` | string | Line item |
| `category` | string | "Gold", "Silver", etc. |
| `grams` | number | null/NaN/0 OR category="Silver" → PC item |
| `source` | string | Facility — used for Dispatch grouping |
| `currency` | string | "AED", "USD", "PHP", possibly others |
| `clientRate` | number | Client-facing price per gram or flat |
| `goldRate` | number | Gold spot rate — writable from Accounts tab |
| `supplierRate` | string | Parse as float — writable from Accounts tab |
| `mc` | string | Making Charge — parse as float — writable from Accounts tab |
| `status` | string | Pending, Waiting for Details, For Pullout, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled |
| `modeOfPayment` | string | Tabby, Tamara, COD, Bank Transfer, Credit Card, Meet Up, Pick Up Shop, Layaway |
| `modeOfSale` | string | In SDK but NOT used — ignore |
| `freeSf` | string | App writes "TRUE" or ""; reads truthy if "TRUE"/"true" |
| `downpayment` | string | Parse as float |
| `la1MonthPayment`–`la4MonthPayment` | string | Parse as float; locked unless MOP = "Layaway" |
| `additionalCharges` | string | Parse as float |
| `amountReceived` | string | Parse as float |
| `remittanceStatus` | string | Pending Payment, Secured via Courier/Bank Transfer/Cash |
| `dispatchDate` | string | Written by app on status → "Dispatched" |
| `deliveredDate` | string | Written by app on status → "Delivered" |
| `liverAdminRemarks` | string | Inline-editable in Admin Pipeline |
| `profit` | string | Ignored — recalculated on the fly |

### `Uploads` Sheet

| SDK Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| `masterlistFile` | URL string saved after file upload to cloud storage |
| `status` | Upload status |
| `uploadId` | Reference ID |

---

## Virtual / Calculated Fields (Frontend Only)

| Field | Formula |
|---|---|
| Due Date | `dateOfLive` + 3 days |
| Item Price | PC item → `clientRate`; weight-based → `grams * clientRate` |
| Item Cost | PC/Silver → `parseFloat(supplierRate) + parseFloat(mc)`; Gold weight → `(goldRate * grams) + parseFloat(mc)` |
| Profit | Item Price − Item Cost |
| AED Conversion | USD × 3.67; PHP ÷ 15.5; AED = no change |
| Shipping Fee | freeSf="TRUE" → 0; MOP="Pick Up Shop" → 0; MOP="Meet Up" → 10; Local: Dubai=25, Western Region=45, others=30 |
| CC Fee | MOP="Credit Card" → 5; else → 0 |
| Total Paid | `downpayment + la1–la4 + amountReceived` |
| Remaining Balance | `(itemPrice + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges) − totalPaid` |
| 24-Hour SLA Flag | currentTime > `dateOfLive` + 24h AND status = "Pending" |

---

## Backend Endpoints

| Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `getRecords` | Yes | Fetch all `Database` rows (no server-side filter) |
| `updateRecord` | Yes | Update a single `Database` row by `rowId` (partial fields). Used for inline edits, status changes, date captures, and Accounts financial edits |
| `getUploads` | Yes | Fetch all `Uploads` rows |
| `createUpload` | Yes | Create a new row in `Uploads` with `masterlistFile` URL and initial `status` |

File upload to cloud storage uses the `zite-file-upload-sdk` on the frontend, which returns a permanent URL that is then passed to `createUpload`.

---

## Frontend Structure

### Global Shell
- Google login gate — unauthenticated users redirected to login
- Role check after login — unrecognized emails → "Access Denied" screen
- Role config in `src/config/roles.ts` — 4 email arrays (admin, dispatch, accounts, bossing)
- Bottom tab navigation — user sees only their 1 assigned tab
- Global search bar — filters by `minerName`, `itemDescription`, `orderId`
- Floating "Upload Masterlist" FAB — opens a sheet/modal with a file picker; on submit, uploads file and creates an `Uploads` record
- Cinzel Bold + Lato loaded via Google Fonts import in `index.css`

### Tab 1: Admin Pipeline (adminEmails)
- Filter: `status` = "Pending" or "Waiting for Details"
- Grouped by `minerName` (Client Profile cards)
- Client Profile card expands to show: Client Name, Date of Live, Due Date, all bundled items
- Inline editing (no modal): `modeOfPayment`, `regions`, `liverAdminRemarks`
- `freeSf` toggle (writes "TRUE" or "" to sheet)
- Quick status dropdown: "For Pullout" or "Cancelled" (cannot set "Waiting for Details" from app)
- Validation gate: "For Pullout" blocked unless MOP filled; if `locationOfMiner` = "Local", `regions` must also be filled
- 24-Hour SLA Alert: bold red OVERDUE badge if status = "Pending" and >24h past `dateOfLive`
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card

### Tab 2: Dispatch Board (dispatchEmails)
- Filter: `status` = "For Pullout" or "Dispatched"
- Grouped: `locationOfMiner` → `source` → `minerName`
- Calculated shipping fee shown per record
- Quick status: "Dispatched", "Delivered", "Cancelled"
- Auto date capture: status → "Dispatched" writes current date to `dispatchDate`; status → "Delivered" writes to `deliveredDate`
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card
- Pullout Report button: printable internal list, `status` = "For Pullout" only, grouped by `source`, includes `minerName`, `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams`, `dateOfLive`, `goldRate`, calculated profit, totals per Source group

### Tab 3: Accounts Tracking (accountsEmails)
- Primary sub-tab: (`status` = "Delivered" OR `modeOfPayment` = "Layaway") AND (`remittanceStatus` empty OR "Pending Payment" OR Remaining Balance > 0)
- Cleared sub-tab: `remittanceStatus` contains "Secured" or "Received"
- Edit Financials form per record: inputs for `goldRate`, `supplierRate`, `mc`, `additionalCharges`, `amountReceived` — all saved back to sheet
- Layaway inputs (`la1`–`la4`) locked unless `modeOfPayment` = "Layaway"
- Remittance dropdown: Pending Payment, Secured via Courier, Secured via Bank Transfer, Secured via Cash
- Displayed calculated fields: Item Price, Item Cost, CC Fee, Shipping Fee, Total Paid, Remaining Balance (AED)
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card

### Tab 4: Bossing Dashboard (bossingEmails)
- Filter: `status` ≠ "Cancelled"
- Date range filter: This Week, This Month, Last 3 Months, Custom Date Range, All Time (default)
- Strictly read-only — no edits, no charts/graphs
- KPI cards (in AED): Total Expected Profit, Total Items Sold, Outstanding Receivables

### Client Invoice Generator (All 3 client-facing tabs)
- Triggered from Client Profile card
- Printable HTML view via `window.print()` — browser can save as PDF
- Header: `dateOfLive`, `minerName`, `regions`, `modeOfPayment`, Due Date
- Line items: `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams`, `clientRate`, calculated Item Price in AED
- Totals: Subtotal + Shipping Fee + Additional Charges + CC Surcharge + Grand Total in AED

---

## Out of Scope
- Adding a "Roles" sheet to Google Sheets (SDK limitation — use email config instead)
- Charts or graphs anywhere in the app
- Writing calculated profit back to the sheet
- True PDF file generation (printable HTML via `window.print()` used instead)
- Setting "Waiting for Details" status from within the app (sheet-only operation)
- Region options for Pinas or International miners (free-text or not required)

| Shipping Fee | freeSf="TRUE" → 0; MOP="Pick Up Shop" → 0; MOP="Meet Up" → 10; Local: Dubai=25, Western Region=45, others=30 |
| CC Fee | MOP="Credit Card" → 5; else → 0 |
| Total Paid | `downpayment + la1–la4 + amountReceived` |
| Remaining Balance | `(itemPrice + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges) − totalPaid` |
| 24-Hour SLA Flag | currentTime > `dateOfLive` + 24h AND status = "Pending" |

---

## Backend Endpoints

| Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `getRecords` | Yes | Fetch all `Database` rows in batches using `offset`/`limit` until exhausted; returns full dataset |
| `updateRecord` | Yes | Update a single `Database` row by `rowId` (partial fields). Used for inline edits, status changes, date captures, and Accounts financial edits |
| `getUploads` | Yes | Fetch all `Uploads` rows |
| `createUpload` | Yes | Create a new row in `Uploads` with `masterlistFile` URL and initial `status` |

File upload to cloud storage uses the `zite-file-upload-sdk` on the frontend, which returns a permanent URL passed to `createUpload`.

---

## Frontend Structure

### Global Shell
- Google login gate — unauthenticated users redirected to login
- Role check after login — unrecognized emails → "Access Denied" screen
- Role config in `src/config/roles.ts` — 4 email arrays: `adminEmails`, `dispatchEmails`, `accountsEmails`, `bossingEmails`
- Bottom tab navigation — user sees only their 1 assigned tab
- Global search bar — filters visible records by `minerName`, `itemDescription`, `orderId`
- Floating "Upload Masterlist" FAB — opens a sheet/modal with a file picker; on submit, uploads file and creates an `Uploads` record
- Cinzel Bold + Lato loaded via Google Fonts import in `index.css`
- Full skeleton loading state shown while all records are fetched on app load

### Tab 1: Admin Pipeline (`adminEmails`)
- Filter: `status` = "Pending" or "Waiting for Details"
- Grouped by `minerName` — one Client Profile card per unique miner (all-time bundle)
- Client Profile card expands to show: Client Name, Date of Live, Due Date, all bundled items
- Inline editing (no modal): `modeOfPayment`, `regions`, `liverAdminRemarks`
- `freeSf` toggle (writes "TRUE" or "" to sheet)
- Quick status dropdown: "For Pullout" or "Cancelled" (cannot set "Waiting for Details" from app)
- Validation gate: "For Pullout" blocked unless MOP filled; if `locationOfMiner` = "Local", `regions` must also be filled
- Confirmation dialog for "Cancelled" only
- 24-Hour SLA Alert: bold red OVERDUE badge if status = "Pending" and >24h past `dateOfLive`
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card

### Tab 2: Dispatch Board (`dispatchEmails`)
- Filter: `status` = "For Pullout" or "Dispatched"
- Grouped: `locationOfMiner` → `source` → `minerName`
- Calculated shipping fee shown per record
- Quick status: "Dispatched", "Delivered", "Cancelled" (confirmation for "Cancelled" only)
- Auto date capture: status → "Dispatched" writes current date to `dispatchDate`; status → "Delivered" writes to `deliveredDate`
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card
- Pullout Report button: printable internal list, `status` = "For Pullout" only, grouped by `source`, includes `minerName`, `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams`, `dateOfLive`, `goldRate`, calculated profit, totals per Source group

### Tab 3: Accounts Tracking (`accountsEmails`)
- Primary sub-tab: (`status` = "Delivered" OR `modeOfPayment` = "Layaway") AND (`remittanceStatus` empty OR "Pending Payment" OR Remaining Balance > 0)
- Cleared sub-tab: `remittanceStatus` contains "Secured" or "Received"
- Edit Financials form per record: inputs for `goldRate`, `supplierRate`, `mc`, `additionalCharges`, `amountReceived` — all saved back to sheet
- Layaway inputs (`la1`–`la4`) locked unless `modeOfPayment` = "Layaway"
- Remittance dropdown: Pending Payment, Secured via Courier, Secured via Bank Transfer, Secured via Cash
- Displayed calculated fields: Item Price, Item Cost, CC Fee, Shipping Fee, Total Paid, Remaining Balance (AED)
- Generate Invoice button on each Client Profile card

### Tab 4: Bossing Dashboard (`bossingEmails`)
- Filter: `status` ≠ "Cancelled"
- Date range filter: This Week, This Month, Last 3 Months, Custom Date Range, All Time (default)
- Strictly read-only — no edits, no charts/graphs
- KPI cards (in AED): Total Expected Profit, Total Items Sold, Outstanding Receivables

### Client Invoice Generator (All 3 client-facing tabs)
- Triggered from Client Profile card
- Printable HTML view via `window.print()` — browser can save as PDF
- Header: `dateOfLive`, `minerName`, `regions`, `modeOfPayment`, Due Date
- Line items: `itemDescription`, `category`, `grams`, `clientRate`, Item Price in **original currency**
- Totals: Subtotal + Shipping Fee + Additional Charges + CC Surcharge + **Grand Total in AED**

---

## Out of Scope
- Adding a "Roles" sheet to Google Sheets (SDK limitation — use email config instead)
- Charts or graphs anywhere in the app
- Writing calculated profit back to the sheet
- True PDF file generation (printable HTML via `window.print()` used instead)
- Setting "Waiting for Details" status from within the app (sheet-only operation)
- Region options for Pinas or International miners
- Editing `modeOfSale` field (ignored throughout)

The full app is now built. Here's a complete summary of everything that was created:

---

## What Was Built — 28 Files

### Foundation
- **`src/index.css`** — Black + gold theme (near-black bg, gold `hsl(43,96%,50%)` primary), Cinzel Bold + Lato via Google Fonts

- **`src/types/index.ts`** — `DatabaseRowType`, `ClientGroup`, `TabProps`
- **`src/lib/calculations.ts`** — All virtual field math: PC item detection, AED conversion, item price/cost, profit, shipping fee, CC fee, total paid, remaining balance, SLA flag, due date
- **`src/lib/formatters.ts`** — Date formatting, currency, grouping helpers, MOP/Region constants

### Backend (4 endpoints)
- `getRecords` — Fetches all rows in 500-row batches
- `updateRecord` — Updates any field(s) on a row
- `getUploads` / `createUpload` — Uploads sheet operations

### All 4 Tabs
- **Admin Pipeline** — Pending/Waiting records grouped by client, inline editing (MOP, Region, Remarks), freeSf toggle, validation gate, OVERDUE badge
- **Dispatch Board** — Triple-grouped (Location → Source → Client), shipping fee display, auto date capture on status change, Pullout Report
- **Accounts Tracking** — Active/Cleared sub-tabs, per-item financials form with live calculation preview, layaway lock logic
- **Bossing Dashboard** — Read-only KPIs in AED, 5 date range options, records list

### Global Features
- Invoice generator (opens printable window, works on all 3 client tabs)
- Upload Masterlist FAB (file picker → cloud storage → Uploads sheet)
- Global search bar on every tab
- Access Denied screen for unrecognized emails

input.content:
## Scope Summary

This is a large update touching all 4 modules plus the upload flow. The changes cover: auto-refresh after upload with uploader tracking, smart auto-fill logic in Admin Pipeline, overdue alerts, dispatch layout improvements with audit trail, and enhanced accounts financials with auto-computed fields.

---

## 1. Upload & Auto-Refresh

**What:** After uploading a masterlist, poll the `Uploads` sheet until `status` changes to "Processed", then auto-refresh the main records. Also store the uploader's email.

**Data:**
- `createUpload` endpoint: save `context.user.email` into the `uploadId` field (renamed to "Staff/Uploader" in the sheet)
- Frontend `UploadMasterlistFAB`: after upload, poll `getUploads` every few seconds; when the row's `status` === "Processed", trigger a full data re-fetch and stop polling
- Need to pass a `refreshRecords` callback from `App.tsx` down to the FAB

---

## 2. Pullout Report Fix (CRITICAL)

**What:** The report is still showing the old Source-based grouping in production. The code looks correct but may have a type mismatch preventing compilation.

**Root cause to investigate:** The SDK now shows `freeSf?: string` but our code was changed to `freeSf?: boolean`. This type mismatch in `src/types/index.ts` may be causing build failures, which means the old bundle is still being served. **Must reconcile `freeSf` type back to `string` across all files.**

**Grouping rules (confirm):** Primary = Date of Live → Secondary = Miner Name. Columns: Item, Category, Grams, Gold/Silver Rate, Expected Profit (AED). No "Client" column (miner name is the section header).

---

## 3. Admin Pipeline — Smart Auto-Fill

**Remarks → MOP auto-detection:**
- If `liverAdminRemarks` contains "TABBY APPROVED" (case-insensitive) → set `modeOfPayment` = "Tabby" AND `freeSf` = true
- If `liverAdminRemarks` contains "COD" → set `modeOfPayment` = "COD"
- Trigger on remarks change (debounced save)

**MOP → Region auto-set:**
- If MOP = "Pick Up Shop" or "Meet Up" → auto-set `regions` = "Dubai"

**Propagate Region & MOP across client group:**
- When user sets Region on one item, update ALL items for the same `minerName` to the same region
- Same for MOP — setting MOP on one item propagates to all items in the same client card

**Show uploader per client:**
- Display `liverName` (the "Liver NAME" field) on the `AdminClientCard` header — this is the admin who uploaded the record

---

## 4. Overdue Alerts

**Problem:** User sees "Due: Mar 05, 2026" but today (Mar 6) shows no OVERDUE indicator.

**Likely cause:** `dateOfLive` values from the sheet may be formatted strings like `"March 04,2026"` that `new Date()` can't parse reliably. Need to add robust date parsing in `calcDueDate` / `isOverdue` (try `parseISO` from date-fns, and also handle common non-ISO formats).

**Behavior:** If `status` === "Pending" AND `now > dueDate` → show red OVERDUE badge (already coded, just needs the date parsing fix).

---

## 5. Dispatch Board Layout

**Layout change:**
- Split into two clear sections with labels: **"FOR PULLOUT"** section on top, **"DISPATCHED"** section below
- Each section has its own heading/divider
- Cards should be **expanded by default** (no need to click arrow to see items)

**Audit trail — last status change:**
- When a dispatch user changes status (Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled), store `context.user.email` alongside the status update
- Display "Last updated by: email" on each item card
- This requires using the `liverAdminRemarks` field or a convention like appending to remarks. **Decision needed:** We don't have a dedicated "lastUpdatedBy" column in the sheet. Options:
  - (A) Use `liverAdminRemarks` to append status change logs
  - (B) Store in a structured format in an existing text field

System Update & Logic Corrections: Please update the app with the following strict logic adjustments. Do not use local UI workarounds for data that needs to be saved.

1. REMOVE Auto-Refresh (Speed Fix):

Remove the polling/auto-refresh behavior after uploading a masterlist. It is causing performance issues and taking too much time. Let the user manually refresh the records when they are ready.

2. Fix Negative Profit Bug (CRITICAL Gold vs. Silver Fallback Logic):

The Category is located in Column J. However, sometimes this column is accidentally left blank during upload, causing the system to mistakenly apply the expensive Gold cost formula to cheap Silver items.

Strict Fallback Rule: If Category contains the word "Silver" (case-insensitive) OR if Category is BLANK and the Client Rate is suspiciously low (e.g., < 150 AED), you MUST apply the Silver computation (Expected Profit = 0 for now).

ONLY apply the Gold formula Cost = (Gold Rate + MC) * Grams if the item is confirmed to be Gold, or if the Client Rate justifies it.

3. Dispatch Status Logic Change ("Given to Shop"):

```typescript
export function calcProfitAED(record: DatabaseRowType): number {
  const category = (record.category || '').toLowerCase();
  const isSilver = category.includes('silver');
  const clientRateVal = clientRateAED(record);
  const isSuspiciouslyLow = !record.category && clientRateVal < 150;
  
  if (isSilver || isSuspiciouslyLow) return 0;
  
  // Only apply Gold formula if confirmed Gold
  const grams = n(record.grams);
  const goldRate = n(record.goldRate);
  const mc = n(record.mc);
  if (!grams) return clientRateVal - (n(record.supplierRate) + mc);
  return (clientRateVal * grams) - ((goldRate + mc) * grams);
}
```

input.content:
## Scope Summary

Two changes: (1) Harden the Dispatch Board dropdown so "Pinas", "International", and "Layaway" orders can ONLY be set to "Given to Shop" or "Cancelled" — never "Dispatched" or "Delivered". (2) Expand the Bossing Dashboard from 3 KPI cards to 8, adding gross sales, cash collected, gold grams sold, product split, and cancelled order value — all in the existing card aesthetic on a 2-column grid.

---

## 1. Dispatch Fix — "Given to Shop"

**Problem:** The `isGivenToShopMode()` function in `DispatchClientCard.tsx` already has the right logic (`region.includes('pinas')`, etc.), but users report it's still showing Dispatched/Delivered for "Pinas" items.

**Root cause investigation & fix:**
- The `region.includes('pinas')` check uses `toLowerCase()` which should handle "Pinas". However, the data may have extra whitespace, or the region value could be something like `"Pinas - Manila"` or `" Pinas"`.
- **Fix:** Add `.trim()` to the region value and also check the `DispatchBoard.tsx` filter — items already in `status === 'Dispatched'` still appear in the dispatched section, and their dropdowns also need the same restriction applied. Currently the dropdown renders for ALL items regardless of current status.
- Ensure the `isGivenToShopMode` check is robust: trim whitespace, and use `includes` (already done) to handle variants like "Pinas - Manila".

**Files to change:** `src/components/dispatch/DispatchClientCard.tsx` (minor hardening of the `isGivenToShopMode` function — add `.trim()`)

---

## 2. Bossing Dashboard Expansion

**Current state:** 3 KPI cards in a single-column grid — Total Expected Profit, Total Items Sold, Outstanding Receivables.

**New cards to add (5 more):**

| Card | Logic | Data fields used |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| **Total Gross Sales** | Sum of `toAED(calcItemPrice(r), r.currency) + calcShippingFee(r) + n(r.additionalCharges)` for non-cancelled items | `clientRate`, `grams`, `currency`, `regions`, `modeOfPayment`, `freeSf`, `additionalCharges` |
| **Actual Cash Collected** | Total Gross Sales − Outstanding Receivables | (derived from above) |
| **Total Grams Sold (Gold)** | Sum of `grams` where `category` does NOT contain "silver" and status ≠ "Cancelled" | `grams`, `category`, `status` |
| **Product Split** | Count of non-cancelled items: Gold (category not "silver") vs Silver (category contains "silver"). Display as `"Gold: X \| Silver: Y"` | `category`, `status` |
| **Value of Cancelled Orders** | Sum of `toAED(calcItemPrice(r), r.currency)` where status = "Cancelled" | `clientRate`, `grams`, `currency`, `status` |

**Layout:** Change grid from `grid-cols-1` to `grid-cols-2` (with first card spanning full width as the highlight). All 8 cards fit in ~4 rows. No charts, no graphs — text-based cards only using the existing `KpiCard` component.

**Card ordering (top to bottom, left to right):**
1. Total Expected Profit *(highlight, full width)*
2. Total Gross Sales | Actual Cash Collected
3. Outstanding Receivables | Value of Cancelled Orders
4. Total Items Sold | Total Grams Sold (Gold)
5. Product Split *(full width or half)*

**Files to change:** `src/components/bossing/BossingDashboard.tsx` (add new metric computations to the `kpis` useMemo, update grid layout to 2-column)

**Existing helpers already available:** `calcItemPrice`, `calcShippingFee`, `calcRemainingBalance`, `toAED`, `clientRateAED` from `src/lib/calculations.ts`. No new utility functions needed.

---

## Assumptions

- "Category = Normal" means the category is anything that does NOT contain the word "silver" (i.e., Gold is the default).
- The existing date range filter on the Bossing Dashboard applies to all new cards as well.
- "Total Grams Sold" counts ALL non-cancelled gold items regardless of delivery status (not just "Delivered").
- The `n()` helper in calculations.ts safely parses string/number/undefined to 0, which covers `additionalCharges` being a string type.

- Item gets delivered (status = 'Delivered', deliveredDate is set)

- Admin sees it as "Review Chasing" and can set: Pending, Chased, Skipped, Completed
- If reviewChasing is Skipped or Completed, it no longer shows in Admin tab

Actually, re-reading: "if the item was delivered within 3 days it will come back to admin tab as review chasing" - I think this means: after delivery, within 3 days of the delivery date, the item appears in the Admin tab for review chasing. input.name: Logo, Bossing Search Fix, and Review Chasing Feature
input.content:
## Scope Summary

Three changes: (1) Add the uploaded MYKABAYAN logo to the Welcome Screen and nav bar, (2) Fix the non-functional search box on the Bossing Dashboard, and (3) Add a "Review Chasing" section to the Admin tab for recently delivered items.

---

### 1. Add Logo

- **Welcome Screen**: Replace the text-only "MYKABAYAN / JEWELLERY CRM" heading with the uploaded logo image (`pasted-image-1772869045245.png`)
- **Nav bar**: For non-super-admin users who currently see the text "MYKABAYAN", show the logo image instead (small version)

---

### 2. Fix Bossing Dashboard Search

**Problem**: The `BossingDashboard` receives `searchQuery` and passes it to `TabHeader` (which renders the search input), but the `filtered` useMemo only filters by date range and cancellation status — it never applies `searchQuery` to the data. The `statusGroups` are built from `filtered` without any search filtering.

**Fix**: Apply `applySearch()` (already exists in `@/lib/formatters`) to the filtered records before computing KPIs and status groups, so the search box actually filters the displayed data.

---

### 3. Review Chasing in Admin Tab

**Flow**:
1. When an item's status is set to "Delivered" (in Dispatch), the `deliveredDate` is already saved
2. If `deliveredDate` is within the last 3 days AND `reviewChasing` is not "Skipped" or "Completed", the item appears in the Admin tab under a new **"Review Chasing"** section
3. The admin can set `reviewChasing` to: **Pending**, **Chased**, **Skipped**, or **Completed**
4. Once set to "Skipped" or "Completed", the item disappears from the Admin tab

**Data**: Uses existing `reviewChasing` and `deliveredDate` fields on `DatabaseRowType` — no schema changes needed.

**UI Changes**:
- **`AdminPipeline.tsx`**: Add a second section below the existing Pending/Waiting cards — titled "Review Chasing" — showing delivered items from the last 3 days that need review
- **New component `ReviewChasingCard.tsx`**: Displays the item info (miner, item, delivered date) with a dropdown to set `reviewChasing` status (Pending / Chased / Skipped / Completed). Compact card style matching the existing admin UI
- **`updateRecord` endpoint**: Already supports updating arbitrary fields, so setting `reviewChasing` works via the existing `onUpdate` handler

### Assumptions

- "Delivered within 3 days" means: the `deliveredDate` is no more than 3 days ago from now (i.e., recently delivered items)
- Items with `reviewChasing` = "Pending" or "Chased" or empty/null still show in the Admin tab review section; only "Skipped" and "Completed" hide them
- The review chasing section appears below the main Pending/Waiting pipeline in the Admin tab

1. Update Database Types (src/types/index.ts)

We have added two new columns directly to the Google Sheet. Please update the DatabaseRowType to include them so the app can read and write to them:

Add tOG?: string; (Maps to the new "T.O.G" column in Google Sheets, which holds dropdown values like 18k, 24k, S-925, etc.)

Add pureWeight?: number; (Maps to the new "PURE WEIGHT" column in Google Sheets)

2. Update Cost Calculation Logic (src/lib/calculations.ts)

We need to change how the absolute item cost (calcItemCostAED) is calculated so it relies on the "Category" column instead of hardcoded rules. Please replace the existing cost calculation with the following logic:

Per Piece (if grams are 0 or empty): Cost = Supplier Rate + MC

If Category includes "Silver Branded": Cost = 32 * Grams (Ignore MC and Gold Rate entirely)

If Category includes "Silver" (Regular): Cost = 15 * Grams (Ignore MC and Gold Rate entirely)

For Gold (or default by weight): Cost = (Gold Rate + MC) * Grams

Note on Selling Price: The Selling Price formula (calcItemPriceAED) should remain Grams * Client Rate for all items. We will map both the "Normal Rate" (for Gold) and "Client Rate" (for Silver) into the client rate column in the database.

3. Update Shipping Fee Logic (src/lib/calculations.ts)

Walk-in and physical store customers should never be charged a shipping fee by default. Please update the calcShippingFee function:

Check the modeOfSale field. If the value is "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive), immediately return 0 for the shipping fee.

Otherwise, proceed with the existing region-based shipping logic.

4. UI Conditional Rendering & Form Clutter

Since we are using one database for two different sales channels, please update the admin forms and Modals (like AdminPipeline or InvoiceModal) with conditional visibility based on the modeOfSale column:

If modeOfSale is "In-Store" or "Walk-in": Hide live-selling specific fields to reduce clutter (e.g., hide liverName, page, fbProfileName, and reviewChasing). Show the physical store fields (e.g., tOG, pureWeight).

If modeOfSale is "Live": Show all the standard live-selling fields.

For Order ID: We will be inputting Barcode Numbers here for in-store sales, and Code/SKUs here for live sales. Ensure the UI labels it simply as "Order ID / Barcode".

5. Financials Form Overhaul

Ensure that when a transaction is marked as Paid (like "Tabby Paid" or "Cash Paid" from walk-ins), the Total Amount is properly pushed to the Amount Received field. If Amount Received is filled, it should immediately reduce the Remaining Balance to 0 to prevent walk-in customers from showing up as having Layaway/Overdue balances.

---

### 1. Update `DatabaseRowType` (`src/types/index.ts`)

Add two new fields to match the Google Sheet:
- `tog?: string` — maps to "T.O.G" column (dropdown: 18k, 24k, S-925, etc.)
- `pureWeight?: string` — maps to "PURE WEIGHT" column (stored as string in the sheet)

Also update `src/api/getRecords.ts` to include `tog` and `pureWeight` in the row schema and field mapping.

---

### 2. Rewrite Cost Calculation (`src/lib/calculations.ts` → `calcItemCostAED`)

New logic based on `category`:
- **Per Piece** (grams = 0 or empty): `supplierRate + mc`
- **Category includes "Silver Branded"**: `32 * grams` (ignore MC, Gold Rate)
- **Category includes "Silver"** (but not "Silver Branded"): `15 * grams` (ignore MC, Gold Rate)
- **Gold / default by weight**: `(goldRate + mc) * grams`

**Important**: Check "Silver Branded" *before* "Silver" so the more specific match wins.

Selling price (`calcItemPriceAED`) stays unchanged: `grams * clientRate`.

---

### 3. Update Shipping Fee (`src/lib/calculations.ts` → `calcShippingFee`)

Add a check at the top of the function: if `modeOfSale` is "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive), return `0` immediately. Then proceed with existing logic.

---

### 4. UI Conditional Rendering (In-Store vs Live)

A helper function `isInStore(record)` checks if `modeOfSale` matches "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive).

**Files to update:**

- **`AdminClientCard.tsx`** header: Hide `liverName` and `fbProfileName` for in-store items.

- **`AdminItemRow.tsx`**: For in-store items, hide the live-specific fields (`liverName` reference is in header, not here). Show editable `tOG` and `pureWeight` fields for in-store items.

- **`DispatchClientCard.tsx`** header: Hide `liverName` for in-store items.

- **`InvoiceModal.tsx`**: Hide live-specific header fields (`Page`, `FB Profile`) for in-store. Label "Order ID" as "Order ID / Barcode".

- **`AdminPipeline.tsx`** → Review Chasing section: Exclude in-store items from the review chasing filter entirely.

- **`AccountsClientCard.tsx`**: No major changes needed — it already shows generic info.

---

### 5. Financials Form Overhaul (`FinancialsForm.tsx`)

**Mode of Sale dropdown**: Add "In-Store" to the options list (alongside Live, Outsource, Dropshipping).

**Conditional field visibility**: When `modeOfSale` is in-store:
- Hide live-specific fields (the form doesn't currently show `liverName`/`page`/`fbProfileName` anyway — those are in the admin cards)
- Show editable `tOG` (dropdown: 18k, 24k, S-925, etc.) and `pureWeight` (number input)

**Auto-fill on "Paid" MOP**: When `modeOfPayment` contains "Paid" (e.g. "Tabby Paid", "Cash Paid", "Card Paid"), auto-calculate the total amount (item price + shipping + CC fee + additional charges) and push it to `amountReceived`. This makes `calcRemainingBalance` return 0.

This auto-fill should trigger when:
- The user selects a MOP value containing "Paid" from the MOP dropdown (in `AdminItemRow`)
- Or when saving financials with a "Paid" MOP

---

### Data & Integration Details

**Google Sheet columns used:**
- `tog` (T.O.G) — read/write, string
- `pureWeight` (PURE WEIGHT) — read/write, string (parsed as number in the app)
- `modeOfSale` (mode of sale) — read/write, existing field
- `modeOfPayment` (mode of payment) — read/write, existing field; new values like "Tabby Paid", "Cash Paid"
- `category` (Category) — read-only, used for cost calculation branching
- `amountReceived` (Amount Received) — write, auto-filled when MOP is "Paid"

**Endpoint changes:**
- `getRecords.ts` — add `tog` and `pureWeight` to the output schema and field mapping

---

### Assumptions

- "Silver Branded" always contains the word "Silver" in the category string, so we check for "silver branded" first, then "silver" as fallback.
- The "Paid" MOP values are new additions (e.g. "Tabby Paid", "Cash Paid", "Card Paid"). We detect them by checking if `modeOfPayment` includes the word "Paid" (case-insensitive).
- The `pureWeight` field is stored as a string in Google Sheets but displayed/edited as a number in the UI.
- The MOP dropdown in `AdminItemRow` needs new options added for "Tabby Paid", "Cash Paid", etc.

input.content:
## Scope Summary

Add full in-store/walk-in sales support alongside the existing live-selling workflow. This includes two new fields, rewritten cost/shipping calculations, conditional UI based on `modeOfSale`, a simplified status flow for in-store items, and auto-filling `amountReceived` when a "Paid" MOP is selected.

---

### 1. Types (`src/types/index.ts` + `src/api/getRecords.ts`)

Add to `DatabaseRowType`:
- `tog?: string` — maps to "T.O.G" column (e.g. 18k, 24k, S-925)
- `pureWeight?: string` — maps to "PURE WEIGHT" column

Update `getRecords.ts` to include `tog` and `pureWeight` in the output schema and field mapping.

---

### 2. Cost Calculation (`src/lib/calculations.ts` → `calcItemCostAED`)

New logic ordered by priority (check "Silver Branded" before "Silver"):
- **Per Piece** (grams = 0 or empty): `supplierRate + mc`
- **Category contains "Silver Branded"**: `32 × grams`
- **Category contains "Silver"**: `15 × grams`
- **Gold / default**: `(goldRate + mc) × grams`

Selling price (`calcItemPriceAED`) is unchanged.

---

### 3. Shipping Fee (`src/lib/calculations.ts` → `calcShippingFee`)

Add early return: if `modeOfSale` is "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive) → return `0`. Existing logic unchanged after that.

---

### 4. MOP Options (`src/lib/formatters.ts`)

Add new "Paid" MOP options to `MOP_OPTIONS`:
- `Cash Paid`, `Tabby Paid`, `Card Paid`

These are added to the existing dropdown in `AdminItemRow`.

---

### 5. Financials Auto-fill (`src/components/accounts/FinancialsForm.tsx`)

When `modeOfPayment` contains the word "Paid" (case-insensitive):
- Auto-calculate total: `itemPriceAED + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges`
- Write that total into `amountReceived` field
- This makes `calcRemainingBalance` return 0

Auto-fill triggers when the MOP dropdown changes (in `FinancialsForm`). Also add "In-Store" to the `modeOfSale` dropdown options.

---

### 6. Admin Pipeline — In-Store Conditional UI (`src/components/admin/AdminItemRow.tsx`)

Helper: `isInStore(record)` — true if `modeOfSale` is "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive).

**For In-Store items:**
- Show editable `T.O.G` dropdown (options: 18k, 24k, S-925, S-999, Platinum) and `Pure Weight` number input
- Status dropdown changes from `[For Pullout, Cancelled]` to `[Delivered, Cancelled]` — skips dispatch flow
- Hide the "Region" dropdown (no shipping region needed)
- Hide the "FREE SF" switch (always free for in-store)

**For Live items:** No change from current behavior.

---

### 7. Admin Client Card Header (`src/components/admin/AdminClientCard.tsx`)

For in-store items, hide `liverName` and `fbProfileName` from the collapsed header summary.

---

### 8. Review Chasing (`src/components/admin/AdminPipeline.tsx`)

Exclude in-store items from the Review Chasing filter:
- Add condition: `isInStore(r)` → skip

---

### 9. Invoice Modal (`src/components/InvoiceModal.tsx`)

- Label "Order ID" field as **"Order ID / Barcode"** (always, since it's used for both)
- For in-store items: hide `Page`, `FB Profile`, `Due Date` from the header info block

---

### Assumptions
- `pureWeight` is stored as a string in Google Sheets but displayed/edited as a number input in the UI.
- The `isInStore` helper is defined locally in each component (or in `calculations.ts`) — no shared utility file needed.
- In-store items will have `modeOfSale` set from the Google Sheet or from the FinancialsForm dropdown.
- The auto-fill of `amountReceived` triggers immediately when a "Paid" MOP is selected in `FinancialsForm` — the user still needs to hit "Save Financials" to persist it.

input.name: In-Store Support: Types, Cost Logic, Shipping, UI Conditionals & Financials
input.content:
## Scope Summary

Add full in-store/walk-in sales support alongside the existing live-selling workflow. This involves two new fields (`tog`, `pureWeight`), rewritten cost/shipping calculations, conditional UI in the Admin Pipeline and Dispatch Board based on `modeOfSale`, a simplified status flow for in-store items, and live auto-fill of `amountReceived` when a "Paid" MOP is selected.

---

### 1. Types & Data (`src/types/index.ts` + `src/api/getRecords.ts`)

Add to `DatabaseRowType`:
- `tog?: string` — "T.O.G" column (e.g. 18k, 24k, S-925)
- `pureWeight?: string` — "PURE WEIGHT" column

Update `getRecords.ts` output schema and field mapping to include both fields.

---

### 2. Cost Calculation (`src/lib/calculations.ts` → `calcItemCostAED`)

New logic (priority order — check "Silver Branded" before "Silver"):
- **Per Piece** (grams = 0 or empty): `supplierRate + mc`
- **Category contains "Silver Branded"**: `32 × grams` (fixed AED rate)
- **Category contains "Silver"**: `15 × grams` (fixed AED rate)
- **Gold / default**: `(goldRate + mc) × grams`

Selling price (`calcItemPriceAED`) is unchanged.

---

### 3. Shipping Fee (`src/lib/calculations.ts` → `calcShippingFee`)

Add early return: if `modeOfSale` is "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive) → return `0`.

---

### 4. MOP Options (`src/lib/formatters.ts`)

Add to `MOP_OPTIONS`: `Cash Paid`, `Tabby Paid`, `Card Paid`.

---

### 5. Financials Form (`src/components/accounts/FinancialsForm.tsx`)

- Add "In-Store" to the `modeOfSale` dropdown options.
- **Live auto-fill**: When MOP changes to any value containing "Paid" (case-insensitive), immediately update the `amountReceived` field in the form state to equal `itemPriceAED + shippingFee + ccFee + additionalCharges`. User still clicks Save to persist.
- Auto-fill clears (resets `amountReceived` to empty) if MOP is changed away from a "Paid" value.

---

### 6. Admin Pipeline — `AdminItemRow.tsx`

- **T.O.G and Pure Weight**: Show for ALL items (not just in-store) — editable fields: `tOG` dropdown (18k, 24k, S-925, S-999, Platinum) and `pureWeight` number input.
- **In-Store status flow**: If `isInStore(record)`, replace the status dropdown options `[For Pullout, Cancelled]` with `[Delivered, Cancelled]`.
- **In-Store field hiding**: If `isInStore(record)`, hide the Region dropdown and FREE SF switch.

Helper: `isInStore(record)` — true if `modeOfSale` is "In-Store", "Walk-in", or "Walk in" (case-insensitive).

---

### 7. Admin Client Card Header (`src/components/admin/AdminClientCard.tsx`)

For in-store items, hide `liverName` and `fbProfileName` from the collapsed header.

---

### 8. Review Chasing (`src/components/admin/AdminPipeline.tsx`)

Exclude in-store items from the Review Chasing filter.

---

### 9. Dispatch Board (`src/components/dispatch/DispatchClientCard.tsx` + `DispatchBoard.tsx`)

In-store items should not appear in the Dispatch Board at all. Filter them out before grouping, similar to how the Review Chasing section excludes them.

---

### 10. Invoice Modal (`src/components/InvoiceModal.tsx`)

- Label "Order ID" as **"Order ID / Barcode"** universally.
- For in-store items: hide `Page`, `FB Profile`, and `Due Date` from the header info block.

---

### Assumptions
- `pureWeight` is stored as a string in Google Sheets; the UI input is a number field that saves back as a string.
- The `isInStore` check is implemented inline in each component (not a shared utility), using the same case-insensitive string match.
- Auto-fill of `amountReceived` resets if the user switches away from a "Paid" MOP — it does not permanently lock the field.
- T.O.G and Pure Weight are saved via the existing `onUpdate` call when changed (debounced, same pattern as remarks).

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, Database } from 'zite-integrations-backend-sdk';

const rowSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  orderId: z.string().optional(),
  dateOfLive: z.string().optional(),
  page: z.string().optional(),
  liverName: z.string().optional(),
  locationOfMiner: z.string().optional(),
  minerName: z.string().optional(),
  itemDescription: z.string().optional(),
  grams: z.number().optional(),
  source: z.string().optional(),
  category: z.string().optional(),
  mc: z.string().optional(),
  goldRate: z.number().optional(),
  supplierRate: z.number().optional(),
  clientRate: z.number().optional(),
  profit: z.number().optional(),
  modeOfSale: z.string().optional(),
  status: z.string().optional(),
  modeOfPayment: z.string().optional(),
  downpayment: z.string().optional(),
  la1MonthPayment: z.string().optional(),
  la2MonthPayment: z.string().optional(),
  la3MonthPayment: z.string().optional(),
  la4MonthPayment: z.string().optional(),
  liverAdminRemarks: z.string().optional(),
  dispatchDate: z.string().optional(),
  deliveredDate: z.string().optional(),
  reviewChasing: z.string().optional(),
  fbProfileName: z.string().optional(),
  regions: z.string().optional(),
  remittanceStatus: z.string().optional(),
  currency: z.string().optional(),
  additionalCharges: z.string().optional(),
  amountReceived: z.string().optional(),
  freeSf: z.boolean().optional(),
  auditTrail: z.string().optional(),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Fetches all records from the Database sheet in batches',
  inputSchema: z.object({}),
  outputSchema: z.array(rowSchema),
  execute: async () => {
    const BATCH_SIZE = 500;
    const allRecords: z.infer<typeof rowSchema>[] = [];
    let offset = 0;

    while (true) {
      const batch = await Database.findAll({ offset, limit: BATCH_SIZE });
      if (!batch || batch.length === 0) break;

      const valid = batch
        .filter(r => r.id != null && r.status && r.status !== '')
        .map(r => ({
          id: r.id,
          orderId: r.orderId,
          dateOfLive: r.dateOfLive,
          page: r.page,
          liverName: r.liverName,
          locationOfMiner: r.locationOfMiner,
          minerName: r.minerName,
          itemDescription: r.itemDescription,
          grams: r.grams != null ? Number(r.grams) : undefined,
          source: r.source,
          category: r.category,
          mc: r.mc,
          goldRate: r.goldRate != null ? Number(r.goldRate) : undefined,

   - In-store items will hide live-selling specific fields and show `tog` and `pureWeight`.
